label: Room 011, DTU Elektro (building 352)
note: highly reverberant shoebox room, very reflective surfaces and no scattering elements; T30 3.0, 2.9, 3.1, 2.8, 2.1, 1.6 s at 125 Hz-4 kHz (Readme.html); the same room 011 (the 'flanking transmission room') as the empty cuboid room of the DTU frequency-response record DTU.13315289, which gives it as 3.31 x 4.41 x 2.97 m with T60 about 2.7 s; 709 plane and 97 sphere receiver points (plane-N, sphere-N), 42 plane rows repeat an earlier position; positions relative to the robot base, no source position given. RIRDB measures T30 of 2.51, 3.08, 2.55, 2.28, 1.73 and 1.44 s at 125 Hz-4 kHz, about 18 % below the Readme's values except at 250 Hz (rt_mid 2.42 s against 2.95 s), while the decays are straight down to the noise and the authors' other record gives about 2.7 s. The robot arm on its wrapped pallet, the loudspeaker and its stand likely add enough absorption to this small, hard room (about 0.5 m2 against some 2.3 m2) to explain the gap.
